proves: the exact undecodable broker bytes and source coordinates derive one stable connector delivery UUID
one PostgreSQL connector-owned poison receipt transitions through publishing and published before source acknowledgement
the DLQ entry carries the connector delivery UUID as its explicit deterministic Iggy broker message identity
reopening the production Forum Search consumer group redelivers the same source offset and delivery UUID while the receipt remains published
redelivery receives AlreadyPublished, emits no second physical DLQ message, and acknowledges the source only before the receipt becomes acknowledged
successful source acknowledgement advances the consumer group to the next raw delivery

identity_invariants: the poison delivery UUID is connector identity and is not a trusted domain event or tenant identity
consumer group, stream, topic, partition, offset and exact bytes are immutable receipt identity
the deterministic DLQ broker message UUID equals the connector delivery UUID
the first observed delivery attempt count remains immutable across redelivery
published is durable before source acknowledgement and acknowledged is durable only after source acknowledgement
non_claims: this source-ready proof does not claim that PostgreSQL or external Iggy execution passed
this proof does not run the server-owned Forum Search consumer loop or its retry backoff
this proof does not inject DLQ publication failure, durable publish-mark ambiguity or poison identity collision
this proof does not establish semantic inbox identity-conflict poison handling
this proof does not execute the Search projector or advance an owner checkpoint
this proof does not establish multi-process serialization, deletion or ACL ordering, Search-disabled recovery or LINK-FORUM-03 completion
